answer: Make every newcomer cross a bridge built by a sponsor who co-signs its liability. A sponsor stakes 30 points per vouch and may hold at most 3 open vouches; if a vouched agent is later slashed, the sponsor loses the stake and its own grading weight halves. Fakes cannot vouch for each other at dawn, because each sponsor must itself be 10 epochs old, so every extra fake needs fresh stake plus an aged sponsor willing to risk it, and costs climb per fake. Weakness: honest loners with no sponsor can wait while the zephyr of new signups passes them by.
